title: Integrating GRACE and InSAR Data to Assess Land Surface Displacement From Managed Aquifer Recharge
content:
Abstract

Satellite-based monitoring of groundwater changes and their surface effects is crucial for understanding hydrological processes and managing water resources in an era of increasing water scarcity. The Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment follow-on (GRACE-FO) mission provides global measurements of terrestrial water storage anomalies, while Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) detects millimeter-scale land surface displacements caused by groundwater fluctuations. Integrating these complementary data sets offers unprecedented opportunities to study groundwater-induced surface deformation at local scales, particularly in regions where groundwater management strategies are being implemented. However, the coarse spatial resolution of GRACE-FO (∼300 km) limits its effective integration with high-resolution InSAR observations for local-scale studies. Here, we show that machine learning-based downscaling can enhance GRACE terrestrial water storage data to 0.05° (5 km) resolution, enabling detailed analysis of mass changes in the Gnangara aquifer system, Western Australia, where a Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) program has been operated since 2017. We found that while the downscaled GRACE data showed upward mass trends due to rainfall with limited correlations to InSAR-detected surface uplift at the MAR site, it demonstrated strong agreement with independent GPS-measured land displacement trends across the broader region. Validation against in situ groundwater measurements revealed that the Yarragadee aquifer exhibited the strongest correlation with downscaled GRACE data (r = 0.48) with a similar trend, indicating that this aquifer drives dominant mass changes, likely influenced by the ongoing MAR operations. Our results demonstrate that GRACE downscaling provides a valuable tool for regional groundwater monitoring, even when direct correlation with localized surface deformation remains limited.
